html:
Look and feel: three directions, kept for a possible future design change

Edwin saw these three directions on 2026-10-11, liked them, and chose not to adopt one yet. This note keeps them as drawn, so a future design change can start from them. Nothing here is being built. What he asked for instead, transitions and small changes on today's screens, is FEAT-0136-TodaysScreensMoveWithConsideredTransitionsAndGetAFewSmallChanges.

Decision record

Defer — 2026-10-11 (user:edwin)

"I like the ideas but I don't think I am ready to go for them yet (so document them for potential a future design change), instead let's focus on the current screens and focus on transitions and small but meaning ful changes for now (for instance should we bring in the finish button?)"

The rest of this note is as it was put to him. Where it says a task follows the pick, that task is deferred with FEAT-0135-EveryScreenLooksAndMovesLikeOneDesignedApp.

The problem and the three directions

The app has no written look to build its screens to, so each screen styled itself and the result feels unfinished. Edwin's words, 2026-10-11: the app should be "visiually striking throughout and ooze with class and clarity". This note shows three directions for that look, each drawn on the same three phone screens, named Instrument, Soft depth or Poster.

The same screens are on a design canvas, where each one can be opened at full size: https://claude.ai/artifact/Vkxm7Azw2esEX1YoBQLGSV. The canvas is private to Edwin.

What is the same in all three

  • The screens and their content. Workouts, the cockpit and rider selection, with the gallery's sample rider (Alex Rivera, FTP 248 W) and the bundled workouts.
  • The colours. Every direction keeps the eight colours shared with the family palette and the zone colours declared in Color.kt. They differ in which colour leads.
  • The ride modes sit at the top of Workouts. That is the recommended answer to a question Edwin has not decided yet (TASK-1049-ThreeInteractionQuestionsAreSettledByTryingVariantsInTheDebugBuild). It is drawn the same way in every direction so that only the look differs between them.
  • A workout's profile is drawn in zone colours. Today every profile is one purple. A rider reads how hard a workout is from the list.
  • Nothing needs blur, 3D or another heavy effect. Each direction is flat fills, lines and at most a soft shadow, so an older tablet draws it easily.

Today

Workouts, the cockpit before START, and rider selection, from the Android gallery.

A · Instrument

Direction A on Workouts, the cockpit mid-ride and rider selection.

The app looks like a bike computer. The ground is flat ink. Thin lines separate things where today a filled card does. Corners are square. Numbers and headings are set in a condensed face, and small labels are capitals. Purple marks only what is selected or the main action, so zone colour is the strongest colour on every screen.

  • Type: Barlow and Barlow Condensed. The app already bundles both for the celebration screen, on Android and iOS, so this adds no dependency.
  • What it is best at: clarity. More fits on a screen without crowding, and the cockpit reads like an instrument.
  • What it costs: it is the least friendly of the three, and can feel technical. Capitals and a condensed face do not exist in Japanese or Chinese, so the look is weaker in those two languages.
  • Rider selection becomes a ranked list with the current rider opened up. Today it is a row of cards.

B · Soft depth

Direction B on Workouts, the cockpit mid-ride and rider selection.

Today's rounded look, finished. Surfaces sit in three tones of the same dark purple, one above the other. Controls are pills. One typeface carries everything, with heavy weights for names and numbers. Purple fills the selected mode, Quick Ride and PAUSE.

  • Type: Manrope, a new typeface. It is free to bundle (SIL Open Font Licence), and a new bundled font needs a risk note.
  • What it is best at: it is the smallest step from today and from the standard Android components, so the fewest screens need rethinking. Rider selection keeps its row of cards.
  • What it costs: it is the least striking. Rounded boxes inside rounded boxes are part of what feels off today, and this direction keeps them and relies on discipline to stay tidy.

C · Poster

Direction C on Workouts, the cockpit mid-ride and rider selection.

Big type and full-width colour. The ride modes are the headline of Workouts. In the cockpit the top of the screen takes the colour of the zone being ridden, so a rider knows the zone from across the room. Rider selection is a cover: the current rider's colour, rating and name fill the screen. Amber is the one colour for actions, and purple steps back.

  • Type: Bricolage Grotesque for headings and numbers and Instrument Sans for text. Both are new and free to bundle (SIL Open Font Licence), and need a risk note.
  • What it is best at: it is the most striking, and the easiest to recognise in a screenshot.
  • What it costs: it is the largest change. Headings this big need care on a small phone and in German and Dutch, where words are longer. Amber leading is a change for an app whose family colour is purple, and the lighter amber the text needs (#D9B46A) is a new colour beside the family's ResAmber.

What each direction does to the cockpit's numbers

All three set the cockpit's numbers in a new typeface and arrange them differently from today. REQ-0231-ATabletCockpitThatFitsTodayDrawsExactlyAsToday says a tablet cockpit that fits today draws exactly as today, so any pick amends that requirement. B changes the arrangement least.

Recommendation

A, Instrument. It uses the typeface the app already ships, so the whole app would match its own newest screens. It is the clearest to read while riding, and the cheapest for an old tablet to draw. If C's cockpit appeals, its zone-coloured interval block can be tried on top of A as a fourth option before the choice is final.

What the pictures do not show

  • Movement. A picture cannot show a transition. The motion rules are written after the pick (TASK-1047-TheDesignSystemStatesTypeSpacingShapesColourRolesIconsAndMotion).
  • A tablet, the light theme and iOS. Only a phone in the dark theme is drawn. The picked direction is drawn on those before it is built.
  • The cockpit's numbers are sample values. The cockpit is drawn 18 minutes into Sweet Spot 3×12 so the numbers have something to show. The gallery picture above is the same workout before START.
  • Languages. Every picture is in English. None of the four typefaces has Japanese or Chinese characters, so those two languages fall back to the system font in every direction.

Out of scope

Where the ride modes sit, where History's filters sit, and what picking a rider does. Those three are tried as working variants in the debug build (TASK-1049-ThreeInteractionQuestionsAreSettledByTryingVariantsInTheDebugBuild), because a picture cannot show how they feel.

Revisions

  • 2026-10-11 — stub created with FEAT-0135.
  • 2026-10-11 — parked. Edwin chose not to pick a direction yet; his words are in the decision record. Status proposed, phase PHASE-999.
  • 2026-10-11 — three directions drawn and described. The pictures are in __attachments__/ and no HTML page is kept, because pictures carry everything here (tools/skills/design-authoring/SKILL.md).
